clauses.reason: Actual December 18, 1998 signed submission to the Vice President satisfies EO13038 §2 and §4; 30 calendar days later is January 17, 1999. This conclusion uses submission, not receipt, publication, or the December31 deadline. Best legal reading: EO13038 itself establishes the committee and its §4 sunset; later EO13102 extends the report schedule while preserving §4. The charter retains the superseded October1/October31 schedule and does not revoke or abolish presidential establishment authority. 1998 CFR .1031(a) requires conformity to later presidential authority; .1027 describes earlier termination by revoking or abolishing establishment authority. Section3(e) delegates FACA functions, not a demonstrated power or action to contradict the specific presidential sunset. The competing delegated-earlier-termination interpretation is explicitly retained for independent review. No extension or separate earlier revocation was located in the bounded sources examined; this negative finding is not proof that none existed. September30 1999 is later formal revocation.
